messages:
Maria: quick sync — proposal for invite orchestration for the March micro-beta. thinking segmented windows + opt-in webhook for heavy customers. who can take the routing matrix?
Jon: I can own the routing matrix. question: do we want region-first or tier-first segmentation?
Anika: tier-first. enterprise customers need VPC/on‑prem option earlier. region fallback after capacity checks.
Priya: agree tier-first. also need to decide consent/telemetry tiers — minimal, standard, diagnostic.
Ken: for outreach cadence, recommend 3-touch over 10 days: invite, reminder, final. A/B test subject lines separately.
Maria: nice. can we sketch flow? short bullets: 1) seed list (existing DP customers) 2) tiered invites 3) auto-fallback to hosted variant if Dedicated unavailable 4) explicit consent page per tier
Jon: sketch:\n```\nseed -> tier-assign -> invite-window -> accept -> provisioning (canary) -> opt-in telemetry webhook\n```
Anika: provisioning step needs SLA gating: if canary fails then rollback to hosted model variant. add `rollback window = 30m`.
Priya: telemetry tiers: minimal=no logs, standard=aggregate metrics, diagnostic=sampled traces + prompts (encrypted, retention 30d). must show in consent UI.
Ken: ok for A/B, I'll build the spreadsheet for cadence and subject lines. sending later today.
Maria: outreach copy draft (feel free to riff):
"Hey — we'd love your help testing a private instance of Redwood Inference. It's low-effort, opt-in, and you can pick telemetry level. Reply and we'll reserve a slot"
Priya: small tweak: call out data handling: "data will remain in your VPC / anonymized for hosted". reduces friction.
Jon: ops question — how many reserved GPU slots per cohort? proposal: 10 seed, 20 rolling, 5 hotfix standby.
Anika: sounds reasonable. we should include a quick acceptance checklist: security review completed, KMS configured, SLA signed, contact points listed.
Maria: acceptance checklist done — can we define launch criteria? my take: 1) 5 design partners onboarded and running 24h without errors, 2) latency P50 within target, 3) no unresolved security issues, 4) feedback loop captures at least 10 distinct regressions
Ken: +1 to those metrics. add retention signal: at least 70% of active DP sessions after 7 days.
Priya: timeline sync — outreach starts next Monday, accept window 14 days, provisioning starts week after. can we automate reminders?
Jon: yes — I've got a simple Lambda to send reminders and a webhook for accept events. will wire to `invites-service` repo.
Anika: important: include an easy opt-out and data delete endpoint in the onboarding flow. legal will want it.
Maria: noted. who will draft the consent UI copy and the data handling blurb? Priya?
Priya: I can do copy and share with legal for sign-off by Thursday.
Ken: I'll upload the cadence sheet and sample subject lines to the thread when ready.
Jon: I'll make a tiny PR to `invites-service` with the webhook payload spec: `{ user_id, tier, accept_ts, telemetry_level }`.
Anika: pinging infra: if Dedicated capacity < threshold we should route to hosted auto-fallback. deploy-bot: please create a capacity alert for `invites-microbeta` threshold 80%
deploy-bot: Created alert `invites-microbeta-capacity` (threshold 80%). Incident channel: #eng-oncall.
Maria: great — next steps: Jon + Ken + Priya to own artifacts (routing matrix, cadence sheet, consent copy). Anika to own provisioning + rollback policy. I'll run outreach kickoff Thurs 10am.
Priya: noted. will post consent draft by Wed EOD.
Ken: cadence sheet incoming in ~2h. :calendar:
Jon: PR opened to `invites-service`. link: https://git.internal/redwood/invites-service/pulls/42 :eyes:
Maria: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source for decisions. if anything changes, @here to flag urgent blockers. :thumbsup:
